# OSINT Entity Resolution

- Purpose: bounded candidate matching among public organizations, software projects, datasets, publications and public registries.
- Version: 1.1.0
- Maturity: scaffolding; no people matching, identity assertion, auto-merge or graph writes.
- Start: README.md
- Contract: docs/RESOLUTION-CONTRACT.md
- Threat model: docs/THREAT-MODEL.md
- Integration gates: docs/INTEGRATION-GATES.md
- Schemas: schemas/
- Library: osint_entity_resolution/
- Tests: tests/
- Dependencies: osint-evidence, schema-registry, identity-trust, policy-engine, audit-provenance, emergency-control, compliance-governance, secure-supply-chain (declared only).
- License: scoped mixed policy; see LICENSE.md. Third-party and data/fixture material requires separate provenance review.
